name: history
summary: Display or manipulate the command history.
description: Display the command history list with line numbers.

options.description: Clear the history list by deleting all entries.
Delete history entry at offset offset.

examples.title: View last 10 commands
examples.output:
1001  sudo apt update
 1002  git status
 1003  npm run dev
examples.explanation: Outputs the last 10 executed shell commands.

warnings: shell history records every command in a plaintext file, including arguments typed after sudo; avoid putting secrets on a command line you keep.
